title: kentia minor
intro: Kentia minor, commonly known as the Kentia Palm or Paradise Palm, is a species of flowering plant in the palm family. This plant has been associated with several health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Kentia minor include promoting relaxation, improving sleep quality, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
